titles.romaji: Code Geass: Hangyaku no Lelouch Picture Drama STAGE 0.97 - Hajimari no Zenya
titles.native: コードギアス 反逆のルルーシュ ピクチャードラマ STAGE 0.97 はじまりの前夜

description: A special included with the Blu-Ray release of the main series. Lelouch monologues on his dissatisfaction with Britannia's rule and the need to hide his and Nunnally's connection to the Britannian throne.
